name: piper
note: Piper-feasible authority (reports/testbed_objects/b_tray_ball_authority.md): front grip, +-8 Nm cap. Linear accel clipped as a vector at 5*a_scale m/s^2, tilt rate clipped at 2*w_scale rad/s, tilt-rate slew alpha rad/s^2. carry_mode clip = same carry paths, clipped by the authority (an authority-limited operator). intensity set so the nominal failure rate is 30-40% with the random mu_roll prior; see README.
tracker_note: tracker_realistic = a simulated camera ball tracker (ASSUMED values: 3 mm, 3 ticks = 60 ms, 30 Hz, 2% dropout); pass --tracker realistic to gen_nominal. Default off.
